sloka: रुदन्बहुविधा वाचः स्नेहदुःखसमन्विताः ।असकृत्पुत्र पुत्रेति वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.७३.३ ॥
transliteration: rudanbahuvidhā vācaḥ snehaduḥkhasamanvitāḥ ।asakṛtputra putreti vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 7.73.3 ॥

translations.english: Weeping, he uttered various words filled with affection and sorrow, repeatedly exclaiming, "O son, O son!"
